name: epctex · Etsy knock-offs, caught nightly.
alt: Animated infographic: epctex, Massive and your code in a stack card. Your design, a moon pendant, is pinned beside a grid of nine Etsy listings found by epctex's Etsy Scraper on Apify through a Massive residential IP. A red reticle steps across the listings, locks onto the one that copies your design, and files it as evidence in a nightly dataset. Headline: Etsy knock-offs, caught nightly.
